title: Mini logging library
hints: Keep the level names in an array `[...]string{"DEBUG", "INFO", "WARN", "ERROR"}`: `String` indexes it after a bounds check, and `ParseLevel` loops over it comparing with `strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(s))`.

`TextLogger.Log` is a single `fmt.Fprintf(l.w, "%s%-5s %s\n", l.prefix, level, msg)` — `%-5s` calls your `String` method because `Level` is a `fmt.Stringer`. `With` returns `&TextLogger{w: l.w, prefix: l.prefix + prefix}`.

`MultiLogger` is a slice type, so its method ranges over the receiver: skip `nil`, append each non-nil error to `var errs []error`, `return errors.Join(errs...)`. `LevelFilter.Log`: `if level < f.Min || f.Next == nil { return nil }; return f.Next.Log(level, msg)`.
